name: Contour Plot
description: A two-dimensional field drawn as filled bands and labelled lines of equal value, with highs and lows marked, like a pressure chart.

props.name: values
props.description: The field as rows of values, first row at the top. Lines are traced through a smooth surface fitted to the grid.

props.name: levels
props.description: The step between lines, e.g. 4 for a line every 4 hPa, or the exact values to draw lines at. Defaults to a round step giving about twelve lines.

props.name: indexEvery
props.description: Every this many lines is drawn heavier. With a step, the heavy lines fall on multiples of the step times this number.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit written after values in the tooltip, legend and summary, e.g. "hPa".

props.name: name
props.description: What the values are, for the tooltip. Defaults to the card label.

props.name: xDomain
props.description: The values at the left and right edges, e.g. longitudes. With formatX, ticks are drawn along the bottom.

props.name: yDomain
props.description: The values at the top and bottom edges, e.g. latitudes. With formatY, ticks are drawn on the left.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Writes x positions on the axis and in the tooltip, e.g. "140°E".

props.name: formatY
props.description: Writes y positions on the axis and in the tooltip, e.g. "42°N".

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip and table. Defaults to one decimal with the unit.

props.name: formatLevel
props.description: Writes the values set along the lines and beside highs and lows. Defaults to the plain number.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colours of the lowest and highest bands; the bands between are mixed from them. Defaults to snow white through pale water.

props.name: extremes
props.description: Mark highs with H and lows with L, each with its value, where the field peaks or bottoms out inside the frame.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels, including the bottom axis. The width follows the card.

props.name: underlay
props.type: (frame: { width: number; height: number; x: (value: number) => number; y: (value: number) => number }) => ReactNode
props.description: SVG drawn over the bands and under the lines, such as a coastline. x and y turn domain values into frame pixels.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the range, the highs and the lows when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline number, already formatted.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the key under the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts note, action, delta and every other prop of a div.
